'''Matwe''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who operated as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Matwe was raised on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and from an early age, he explored the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]] with his brother [[Rikard (Human)|Rikard]] and became known within Coruscant's criminal community. After entering the service of the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]] as smugglers, Rikard became indentured to the cartel after botching a job for the Pykes, and Matwe vowed not to abandon his brother. Matwe was later among a group of Pyke-affiliated operatives who were assigned to hunt down the rogue [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Kaa'to Leeachos]].<ref name="Under a Black Sun" />
